t: This is the terrace at one to twenty-nine Pelham Place, in Kensington and Chelsea. It was designed by George Basevi, an architect who trained under Sir John Soane. Basevi worked in both Neoclassical and Gothic Revival styles, and his designs included Belgrave Square in London and the Fitzwilliam Museum in Cambridge. He was also surveyor to the Thurloe estate, which is the link to this neighbourhood.
